name: gstack
description: Adds sprint-style slash-command skills to Claude Code and other agents for planning, review, QA, and shipping, plus a bundled headless Chromium browse daemon.

skills.name: Browser Driving
skills.description: Drives the Aside browser or gstack's bundled headless Chromium with /browse for real sessions, clicks, and screenshots.

skills.name: QA Testing
skills.description: Explores browser, API, CLI, and webhook behavior with /qa, writes failing regressions, fixes the cause, and re-verifies.

skills.name: Code Review
skills.description: Finds bugs that pass CI but break in production with /review, auto-fixing the obvious ones and flagging gaps.

skills.name: Ship And Deploy
skills.description: Runs tests, audits coverage, and opens a PR with /ship, then merges and verifies production with /land-and-deploy.

skills.name: Shared Browser Pairing
skills.description: Shares gstack's browser with another agent such as Codex or Cursor via /pair-agent, giving each agent its own tab.
